title: Structural local finite-free construction
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-pc-flat-model-finite-free-shortening there exist V ≤ U, P, and a quasi-isomorphism eP : P ⟶ (V → U)^*C, with t ∈ V, P supported in [0,d], and every P term finite free.

proof.text: Construct the local finite-free replacement and retain its induced quasi-isomorphism to the restriction of C; the remaining proof is recorded as a named stage-3 hole.

lean.statement: theorem exists_local_finiteFree_construction {T : Scheme.{u}} (U : T.Opens) (C Q : CochainComplex U.toScheme.Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ) (hCge : C.IsStrictlyGE 0) (hCle : C.IsStrictlyLE d) (hCflat : ∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsFlatOver (𝟙 U.toScheme)) (hQle : Q.IsStrictlyLE d) (hQfree : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (Q.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)))) (e : Q ⟶ C) (he : QuasiIso e) (t : T) (ht : t ∈ U) : ∃ (V : T.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ U) (P : CochainComplex V.toScheme.Modules ℤ), (t ∈ V ∧ P.IsStrictlyGE 0 ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE d ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (P.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))))) ∧ ∃ (eP : P ⟶ ((Modules.pullback (T.homOfLE hVU)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj C), QuasiIso eP
